patterns.note: Full-bleed video hero with centered, large white text and two distinct call-to-action buttons.
The navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid white background with dark text, while remaining sticky at the top.
The hero background video parallaxes subtly upwards as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth behind the static text content.

A bright, clear blue is used as a primary accent color for call-to-action buttons and interactive elements, standing out against a largely monochromatic (white, black, grey) and dark natural (hero video) palette.
Content sections are clearly delineated by alternating background colors (white, light grey, black) to create visual breaks and hierarchy.

technique_notes: A sticky header transitions from a transparent overlay with white text to a solid white background with dark text and reduced height, likely using CSS transitions or keyframes for a smooth effect.
The hero section utilizes a full-bleed background video that subtly parallaxes upwards as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic and immersive initial experience.
Content sections appear to reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized bold hero (~3-4x body) with clear, structured heading hierarchy and legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: subtle (buttons) to sharp (cards and overall structure)
design_tokens.spacing: airy (hero) to balanced (content sections) with consistent vertical rhythm.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a full-bleed, high-quality video hero immediately conveys its mission and creates an immersive, impactful first impression. The subtle parallaxing of this video adds a sophisticated layer of motion that elevates it beyond a static image or simple video loop.
